findings.violating_statement: The section does not specify the intended purpose of the Double J Stent (Short Term) as required for the clinical evaluation plan.
findings.source_quote: The scope of this clinical evaluation includes the Double J Stent (Short Term), designed and manufactured by Biorad under the brand name DJS as mentioned below.
findings.explanation: Annex XIV Part A (1)(a) requires the clinical evaluation plan to include a clear specification of the intended purpose of the device, which is absent from the provided text.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a statement such as: "Intended purpose: The Double J Stent (Short Term) is intended for temporary ureteral drainage following urological procedures."

findings.violating_statement: The section lacks identification of the intended target groups, indications, contraindications and clinical benefits, which are mandatory elements of the clinical evaluation plan.
findings.source_quote: Table 1: Product Scope Trade Names; Double J Stent (Short Term): Double J Stent (Short Term). Variants; Double J Stent (Short Term): Please see attached annexure for variants.
findings.explanation: Annex XIV Part A (1)(a) requires a clear specification of intended target groups with indications and contraindications, as well as a detailed description of intended clinical benefits; none are provided.
findings.suggested_correction: Include a section detailing target patient population, indications, contraindications and expected clinical benefits, e.g., "Target group: adult patients requiring short‑term ureteral stenting; Indication: postoperative ureteral drainage; Contraindication: active urinary infection; Clinical benefit: maintains ureteral patency and reduces postoperative pain."

findings.violating_statement: No evidence is provided that equivalence to a similar device has been demonstrated, which is required when clinical data from equivalent devices are used.
findings.source_quote: The scope of this clinical evaluation includes the Double J Stent (Short Term), designed and manufactured by Biorad under the brand name DJS as mentioned below.
findings.explanation: Annex XIV Part A (3) mandates that, if equivalence is claimed, technical, biological and clinical characteristics must be demonstrated. The excerpt does not mention any equivalence assessment or supporting data.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a paragraph demonstrating equivalence, e.g., "The Double J Stent (Short Term) is equivalent to Device X in design, material (polyurethane), duration of use, and clinical indication, as shown in Table Y."

raw.violating_statement: The PRRC entry does not include the required address and full contact details as required by Annex VI Part A point 1.4
raw.source_quote: Table 3: Details of Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) Name: Phone; Mr. Sudhakar Saxena: +41 447090101. Name: Email.
raw.explanation: Annex VI A.1 mandates that the name, address and contact details of the person(s) responsible for regulatory compliance be provided. The CER only lists name and phone, omitting the address, thus non‑compliant.
raw.suggested_correction: Table 3: Details of Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) Name: Mr. Sudhakar Saxena; Address: [full address]; Phone: +41 447090101; Email: [email address].

raw.violating_statement: No evidence of the PRRC’s requisite expertise or qualifications is provided, as required by Article 15(1)
raw.source_quote: Table 3: Details of Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) Name: Phone; Mr. Sudhakar Saxena: +41 447090101. Name: Email.
raw.explanation: Article 15(1) requires that the PRRC possess the requisite expertise in medical devices, demonstrated by specific qualifications. The report only lists name and phone, without any qualification details, breaching the clause.
raw.suggested_correction: Include a statement such as: "Mr. Sudhakar Saxena holds a degree in biomedical engineering and 5 years of experience in medical device regulatory affairs, meeting the expertise requirements of Article 15(1)."

findings.violating_statement: The report lists Basic UDI‑DI codes but does not demonstrate that the Basic UDI‑DI was assigned before the manufacturer applied to the notified body, as required by Art.29.3.
findings.source_quote: Basic UDI-DI Codes: Double J Stent & Kit Blue (Short Term); 890551639TL.
findings.explanation: Art.29.3 mandates that the assignment of a Basic UDI‑DI be completed before the manufacturer applies to a notified body for conformity assessment. The CER section merely lists the codes without any statement confirming the timing of the assignment, leaving it unclear whether the requirement is met.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a statement such as: "The Basic UDI‑DI was assigned on [date] prior to the application to the notified body for conformity assessment, in accordance with Art.29.3 of the MDR."

findings.violating_statement: The device description does not provide the user/patient information required on warnings, precautions, contraindications and limitations of use.
findings.source_quote: Double J Stent is used for treatment of the upper urinary tract are implantable devices that support the flow of the urine from the kidneys to the bladder.
findings.explanation: Annex I, clause 23(s) requires that the clinical evaluation report include information that allows the user and/or patient to be informed of any warnings, precautions, contraindications, measures to be taken and limitations of use. The provided section contains only a functional description and does not contain any such safety information.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a subsection titled "Safety Information and Warnings" that lists all relevant warnings, precautions, contraindications, and usage limitations for the Double J Stent, e.g., risk of migration, infection control measures, contraindications in patients with urinary tract obstruction, etc.

findings.violating_statement: The report does not provide a confirmation that the device meets defined chemical and/or physical specifications as required by Annex I 10.h.
findings.source_quote: Material; Specifications: Stent: Polyurethane (White/Blue) Pusher: Polypropylene String/Suture: Polypropylene Guidewire (in kit): SS 304 with PTFE coating / Nitinol with hydrophilic coating.
findings.explanation: Annex I 10.h requires a confirmation that the device meets any defined chemical and/or physical specifications. The CER lists materials but does not state that these specifications have been verified or met.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a statement such as: "All materials have been tested and confirmed to meet the defined chemical and physical specifications in accordance with the applicable standards (e.g., ISO 10993, ISO 10993‑1)."

findings.violating_statement: The report lacks evidence that the sterile state of the device and packaging integrity are ensured as required by Annex I 11.d.
findings.source_quote: Sterilization Method; Specifications: Ethylene Oxide (EtO) sterilized.
findings.explanation: Annex I 11.d mandates that devices delivered in a sterile state must be designed, manufactured, packaged and sterilised by validated methods and that packaging integrity be evident to the user. The CER only mentions the sterilisation method without confirming validation, sterility assurance, or packaging integrity.
findings.suggested_correction: Include a statement such as: "The EtO sterilisation process is validated according to ISO 11135, providing a sterility assurance level of 10⁻⁶. Packaging integrity is verified by visual inspection and pressure decay testing, ensuring sterility is maintained until opening at the point of use."

findings.violating_statement: The report does not provide the required chemical and physical specifications for the device materials as required by Annex I 10.h.
findings.source_quote: The device materials have undergone biological safety evaluation in accordance with the ISO 10993 series to ensure biocompatibility for their intended duration and type of contact.
findings.explanation: Annex I 10.h mandates confirmation that the device meets defined chemical and/or physical specifications. The CER only references biocompatibility testing (ISO 10993) and does not present the chemical/physical specification data (e.g., composition limits, residue levels, sterilisation validation).
findings.suggested_correction: Include a table or statement that lists the chemical composition, purity grades, residual monomer limits, and any other relevant physical specifications for each material (polyurethane, polypropylene, LDPE, stainless steel, nitinol) and confirm they meet the defined specifications.

findings.violating_statement: The section lacks the basic device identification information required by Annex VI A.2 (e.g., UDI‑DI, risk class, member states, reprocessed status).
findings.source_quote: The Double J Stent (Short Term) consists of the following components and materials, as defined in the TCF/DJS/61:
findings.explanation: Annex VI A.2 requires the technical documentation to contain basic device information such as the UDI‑DI, risk class, reprocessed single‑use status, and member states where the device is placed on the market. The CER excerpt only lists components and materials and does not include any of these mandatory data elements.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a dedicated subsection that provides the basic device information: UDI‑DI, device type, risk class (e.g., Class IIb), reprocessed single‑use status (No), member states of distribution, and any relevant certificate details.

findings.violating_statement: The CER section does not provide the user‑or patient‑focused information on warnings, precautions, contraindications, measures to be taken or limitations of use required by Annex I.23.s.
findings.source_quote: Devices that support the flow of the urine from the kidneys to the bladder. These are made available with tapered ends to allow for ease of introduction over a compatible guidewire. Further its smooth surface also provides for lesser trauma for the patients.
findings.explanation: Annex I.23.s mandates that the clinical evaluation report include information that allows the user and/or patient to be informed of any warnings, precautions, contraindications, measures to be taken and limitations of use. The provided text only describes device function and construction and omits any such safety information, constituting a breach of the clause.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a dedicated subsection that lists all relevant warnings, precautions, contraindications, measures to be taken and limitations of use for the Double J Stents, including handling of the polypropylene thread, guidewire compatibility, and any environmental or usage constraints.

raw.violating_statement: The section does not provide any information on warnings, precautions, contraindications, measures to be taken or limitations of use as required by Annex.I.23.s
raw.source_quote: The Double J Stent (Short Term) is a passive, implantable ureteral stent intended to support urine flow from the kidney to the bladder in cases of ureteral obstruction or impaired drainage.
raw.explanation: Annex.I.23.s mandates that the clinical evaluation report include information that allows the user and/or patient to be informed of any warnings, precautions, contraindications, measures to be taken and limitations of use regarding the device. The provided mechanism of action description contains no such information, representing a compliance gap.
raw.suggested_correction: Add a subsection titled "Warnings, Precautions and Limitations of Use" that details any known warnings (e.g., risk of migration, infection), contraindications (e.g., active urinary infection), precautions during placement, and limits of use (e.g., maximum dwell time of 30 days).

findings.violating_statement: The intended use section does not specify the sterilisation method for the single‑use sterile device, as required by the MDR.
findings.source_quote: This is a single use sterile device which is used for internal drainage from Kidney to Bladder in medical conditions like improper urine drainage, calculi in ureter, hydronephrosis, oxalate calculi, pyeloplasty with UPJ Obstruction, residual renal calculus, ureteral stricture.
findings.explanation: Clause [Annex.I.23.l] mandates that if a device is supplied sterile, the CER must indicate its sterile state and the sterilisation method. The text only states the device is sterile but provides no information on the sterilisation method, constituting a non‑compliance.
findings.suggested_correction: Include a statement such as: "The device is supplied sterile, using ethylene oxide sterilisation (ISO 11135) with validated parameters and sterility assurance level of 10⁻⁶."

findings.violating_statement: Missing indication of the sterilisation method for the sterile device
findings.source_quote: This is a single use sterile device used for internal drainage from Kidney to Bladder
findings.explanation: Annex I.23.l requires that if the device is supplied sterile, an indication of its sterile state and the sterilisation method must be provided, which is absent.
findings.suggested_correction: Include a statement such as "The device is supplied sterile, sterilised by gamma irradiation (or appropriate method)."

findings.violating_statement: Missing instructions for damaged or unintentionally opened sterile packaging
findings.source_quote: This is a single use sterile device used for internal drainage from Kidney to Bladder
findings.explanation: Annex I.23.l#1 mandates instructions in case the sterile packaging is damaged or opened before use, which are not provided.
findings.suggested_correction: Provide instructions, e.g., "If the sterile packaging is damaged or opened, do not use the device and contact the manufacturer."

findings.violating_statement: No statement addressing microbial leakage reduction during use
findings.source_quote: This is a single use sterile device used for internal drainage from Kidney to Bladder
findings.explanation: Annex I.11.c requires measures to reduce microbial leakage or exposure during use, which are not mentioned in the description.
findings.suggested_correction: Include a statement describing design or handling measures that minimise microbial leakage, e.g., "The device is designed to minimise microbial exposure during internal drainage."

findings.violating_statement: The intended patient population description does not provide the required information on warnings, precautions, contraindications, measures to be taken and limitations of use for the device.
findings.source_quote: These medical conditions commonly occur in adult Male, Female during urological procedures.
findings.explanation: Annex I, clause 23(s) requires that the clinical evaluation report include information that allows the user/patient to be informed of any warnings, precautions, contraindications, measures to be taken and limitations of use. The provided section only lists medical conditions and demographic groups and omits any such safety information, thus breaching the clause.
findings.suggested_correction: Include a subsection that details all relevant warnings, precautions, contraindications, required measures and limitations of use for the Double J Stent (Short term), e.g., "Warnings: do not use in patients with known allergy to device materials; Precautions: ensure proper placement under imaging guidance; Contra‑indications: active urinary infection, severe ureteral obstruction; Limitations of use: intended for short‑term use up to 6 weeks only."

findings.violating_statement: The CER does not contain the mandatory indication that the device is a medical device as required by Annex I.23.q
findings.source_quote: The Double J Stent (Short Term) is intended to be used by qualified healthcare professionals trained and experienced in urological procedures.
findings.explanation: Annex I.23.q requires the clinical evaluation report to include an indication that the device is a medical device. The provided section only describes intended users and settings but lacks any statement confirming the device’s status as a medical device.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a statement such as: "The Double J Stent (Short Term) is a medical device intended for ..." to satisfy the requirement.

findings.violating_statement: The section mentions similar generic devices but does not provide the required technical, biological and clinical characteristic comparison to demonstrate equivalence as required by Annex XIV A.3.
findings.source_quote: The Double J Stent/Kit (Long Term) is a first-generation device. However, similar generic devices have been on the market for some time and have well-established technology (WET)
findings.explanation: Annex XIV A.3 mandates that a clinical evaluation based on equivalence must include a detailed, scientifically justified comparison of technical, biological and clinical characteristics. The CER only states that similar devices exist without the required comparative data, thus the equivalence claim is unsupported.
findings.suggested_correction: Add a detailed equivalence justification that compares the Double J Stent/Kit to the referenced generic devices, covering design, materials, intended use, clinical condition, population, and performance characteristics, and demonstrate that any differences are not clinically significant.

findings.violating_statement: The report does not provide the required justification of equivalence for the alternative devices as required by Annex XIV.A.3, nor does it demonstrate that the technical, biological and clinical characteristics are sufficiently similar to preclude clinically significant differences.
findings.source_quote: The following table provides a comparison of the Double J Stent (Short Term) with alternative treatment options available for the management of ureteral obstruction and impaired urinary drainage.
findings.explanation: Annex XIV.A.3 mandates that a clinical evaluation based on equivalence must include a detailed, scientifically justified comparison of technical, biological and clinical characteristics. The CER section only lists alternative treatments and their benefits/risks without any analysis demonstrating similarity of design, materials, intended purpose, or performance, thus failing to meet the clause.
findings.suggested_correction: Include a dedicated subsection that systematically compares the Double J Stent with each alternative on the technical, biological and clinical criteria listed in Annex XIV.A.3, providing scientific justification that any differences are not clinically significant.

findings.violating_statement: The report states that no clinical investigation was performed based solely on MDR article 61, without demonstrating that an exemption under Art.61.4 applies.
findings.source_quote: Hence, according to MDR article 61, no clinical investigation was performed.
findings.explanation: Art.61.4 requires a clinical investigation for implantable devices unless the device is a modified version of a marketed device and equivalence has been demonstrated and endorsed by the notified body. The CER provides no evidence of such equivalence or notified‑body endorsement, so the claim of exemption is unsupported and breaches Art.61.4.
findings.suggested_correction: Provide evidence that the Double J Stent/Kit is a modification of a previously marketed device and that equivalence has been demonstrated and endorsed by the notified body, or conduct a clinical investigation in accordance with MDR requirements.
